title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
summary: Find the lowest common ancestor of nodes p and q.
approach: Post-order: return the node if it is p or q; if both subtrees return non-nil, the current node is the LCA.
body: iOS link: finding the common superview of two views (walk up `superview` chains with a set) is the parent-pointer version of this.
